content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The only non-compete in the Agreement is Section 5.8 (Exclusivity with Respect to the Territory), which binds **Harpoon** and its Affiliates from developing, commercializing or enabling third parties to exploit any Competing Product in the Territory. That restraint runs in our favour, and Section 5.8.2's Acquisition/Change-in-Control carve-outs also operate on Harpoon while granting AbbVie discretionary protections (Segregation, ability to cut off Confidential Information flow, and to disband the JGC).

Targeted searches for restraints on our side ("AbbVie shall not", "Competing Product", "directly or indirectly, develop", "compete") turned up no field-of-use, territory or competing-product restriction binding AbbVie; the AbbVie covenants at Section 10.4 are limited to securing IP rights from Affiliates, Sublicensees and personnel. This satisfies the preferred position — no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on the Customer. Per the planner note, the Section 5.8 restraint is left to the EXCLUSIVITY rule and not double-flagged here.
